source.caption: Maximum number of target integrals [r](0) per batch required for 1, 3, 6 and 9 batches as L varies. Bolded values indicate that this number of batches obtains the minimum execution time for a kernel with angular momentum L.
source.transcription: Read from a 200 dpi render of PDF page 12, and diffed cell by cell against the PDF's text layer; the two reads agree in all 40 cells.

quantity.description: Largest number of target integrals [r](0) assigned to any one batch.

rows.name: L
rows.description: Total angular momentum of the [p|q] class.

columns.name: batches
columns.description: Number of batches the targets [r](0) are split into (Algorithm 4).

notes: The one-batch column is pure combinatorics, the number of Hermite triples (t, u, v) with t + u + v <= L: (L+1)(L+2)(L+3)/6.
Every row falls strictly left to right: more batches put fewer targets in each.
Bold marks the batch count(s) with the fastest measured kernel at that L (A100). It is annotation, not data, and is not recorded here.
